proposed_mitigation: No physical FC, motors, actuators, radio or aircraft connected to allocated host/namespace
enforcement_mechanism: Owner chooses physically separated development node; hardware inventory and no vehicle routes; no FC passthrough
verification_method: Independent signed hardware/host inventory and topology; later bounded inert boundary validation
required_evidence: Host/asset assignment, deny policy, signed custody and peer/device evidence
failure_mode: Undeclared NIC/device/remote bridge or hotplug bypass
residual_risk: Host/operator trust remains; no current physical exclusion proof

proposed_mitigation: Exclude ttyS/ttyUSB/ttyACM/USB bus/CAN/radio device interfaces, not just no current FD
enforcement_mechanism: Minimal device namespace, default device deny with GPU-only exception; no serial/USB/CAN mount or hotplug grant
verification_method: Static mount/capability/device policy plus separately authorized inert denial checks without real hardware
required_evidence: Effective device/cgroup/namespace/hotplug export and negative-check records
failure_mode: GPU/privilege blanket grant exposes host devices
residual_risk: Kernel/runtime policy failure and undisclosed physical network paths

proposed_mitigation: No privileged Docker-in-Docker, host PID/network/user/device blanket grant or runtime admin socket
enforcement_mechanism: Direct native unprivileged runtime; drop capabilities, non-root/no-new-privileges, reviewed seccomp/LSM; allow only exact GPU needs
verification_method: Owner capability evidence and effective runtime policy inspection; separately authorized inert checks
required_evidence: Runtime/UID/capability/LSM/device manifests and supported GPU evidence
failure_mode: Orchestrator silently injects privilege, broad GPU nodes or unsafe defaults
residual_risk: Unprivileged GPU/Isaac compatibility unverified; failure requires redesign, never automatic exception

proposed_mitigation: Exclude checkout/ROS/cache shared writable mounts and host control/device sockets
enforcement_mechanism: Immutable image/source/scene/config RO; per-attempt private bounded cache/spool; collector has read-only data view; no docker.sock/kube/admin mounts
verification_method: Offline mount manifest review then effective runtime attestation before activation
required_evidence: Mount paths/modes/owners/content hashes and private-volume identities
failure_mode: Writable overlay changes code/config or shared cache affects other workloads
residual_risk: Read-only source does not pin mutable remote assets; copied caches require provenance

proposed_mitigation: Only PX4↔Pegasus TCP and PX4↔MAVROS UDP inside isolated software namespaces
enforcement_mechanism: Exact peer/sysid/compid/ports and network firewall allowlist; no serial FCURL, GCS endpoint or general telemetry broadcast
verification_method: Static endpoint manifests and passive effective tables; separate isolated inert enforcement tests
required_evidence: Generated bind/peer/route/filter exports, socket ownership and permitted boot-traffic inventory
failure_mode: UDP peer override/default fallback/broadcast or extra PX4 instance escapes
residual_risk: SITL may expose additional control APIs; no physical boundary assumed from FCURL alone

proposed_mitigation: Dedicated discovery namespace/domain with no operational participants or cross-domain routers
enforcement_mechanism: Default-deny network with exact generated DDS ports/peers; reviewed DDS identities/permissions, fail closed if policy absent
verification_method: Owner RMW/security support proof; offline profile validation then authorized inert identity/discovery checks
failure_mode: Multicast or router/policy fallback leaks domain into operational systems
residual_risk: Unique domain alone insufficient; security/plugin support unverified

proposed_mitigation: Exclude DDS routers/action relays/mission consoles/gossip bridges entirely from rig artifacts/process graph
enforcement_mechanism: No GCS/Cosmos/relay packages or entrypoint; middleware permissions deny arming/mode/action/setpoint interfaces; exact guard parameter services only
verification_method: Dependency/entrypoint allowlist and artifact review; inert negative topic/service policy checks under separate scope
required_evidence: Package/process/API/permission manifest and startup effective graph attestation
failure_mode: Unexpected plugin/package auto-starts bridge or wildcard permissions
residual_risk: MAVROS plugin may expose command APIs internally; never assert all eliminated without validation

proposed_mitigation: No operational network or unbounded external ingress/egress during trial
enforcement_mechanism: Stage images/assets before window; deny trial-time internet/Nucleus/registry/SSH/WebRTC/GCS ports; authenticated separate management plane only
verification_method: Static firewall/asset dependency review; owner policy exports and authorized inert enforcement tests
required_evidence: Offline asset closure and no default route/egress or explicit reviewed management policy
failure_mode: Remote asset fetch or permissive management path bridges data network
residual_risk: Assets may require online service/licence; confirm offline capability or return for redesign

proposed_mitigation: Exclude autonomy, task servers/controllers/planners, saved-goal replay and GCS from minimal process/image allowlist
enforcement_mechanism: Diagnostic guard host instantiates guard class without full command-capable robot interface; dedicated reviewed launch, no airstack up/full stack autolaunch
verification_method: Offline source/dependency diff review; eventual process/API/traffic allowlist verification
required_evidence: Guard-host source/build/plugin/process/API manifests and semantic comparison
failure_mode: Transitive launcher/plugin/entrypoint recreates mission or controller publisher
residual_risk: New diagnostic host changes integration context and cannot qualify production interface behavior

hazard_or_exposure: Actuation/arming APIs and permitted startup transaction
proposed_mitigation: No harness arming/mode/motion clients or publishers; only original guarded normalized Set/Get transaction
enforcement_mechanism: Guard host exposes readiness/status and actual state subscriptions; allow only setpoint_raw parameter Get/Set double1.0 under unchanged safe-state/deadline/latch rules; no manual repair
verification_method: Source-level endpoint allowlist plus separately authorized inert denial checks; then scoped startup observation
required_evidence: Exact allowed boot/API/type/value/provenance and transaction trace; no parameter write performed in E1C
failure_mode: Wildcard endpoint or MAVROS plugin accepts control from unauthorized process
residual_risk: Source guard publishes status and one config transaction, not globally one-way telemetry; peer/physical denial still mandatory

proposed_mitigation: Separate authenticated operator management from experiment data; no unowned remote terminal/control console
enforcement_mechanism: Named least-privilege operator and independent stop owner; management identity scoped to job; no credential injection into raw evidence
verification_method: Delegation/expiry/identity record and approved access review; later inert access validation if necessary
required_evidence: Signed assignments, identity/policy/scope and exact workflow stop manifest
failure_mode: Shared credentials or stale PID/workflow acts on wrong workload
residual_risk: Named owners/actual platform management policy missing

hazard_or_exposure: Emergency termination, resource and evidence failure
proposed_mitigation: Bounded target-only stop/recovery with independent evidence after executor loss
enforcement_mechanism: Finite approved CPU/RAM/GPU/duration/storage/capture bounds, no auto-restart, out-of-job supervisor with durable spool; exact workflow/PID identities and abort escalation
verification_method: Offline termination design then separately approved inert normal/executor-loss/stop tests, later simulator scope
required_evidence: All process exit/clock/drop/abort records, durable archive receipt and capacity/limit evidence
failure_mode: Job death kills recorder, storage fills, unsafe leftover or blanket kill affects another workflow
residual_risk: Independent supervision/durability not demonstrated; safety may override complete capture
